mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO rise sequentially, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), higher interest rates increase borrowing costs for corporations and reduce the present value of future earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.0% year-over-year) and persistently low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a 'transitory inflation' environment where the central bank delays rate hikes, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong economic growth regime (quarterly GDP growth rate > 2.0%), corporate earnings expansion and consumer confidence drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and business investment, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
